title: [PayablesAgent] Add support for credit memos, recognised from the PDF and applied to the original invoice
summary: The Payables Agent now recognizes vendor credit notes in PDFs (EN 16931 type 381) and creates purchase credit memos instead of invoices. A credit memo is applied to the invoice printed on the document only when exactly one open posted invoice of the pay-to vendor matches; otherwise it stays unapplied with a warning.
key_points: Extraction returns the EN 16931 document type code and billing reference; code maps 381 to a credit memo, anything else to an invoice
Creates purchase credit memos with the same draft and task experience as invoices
Applies only to the stated invoice when exactly one open posted invoice of the pay-to vendor matches in an applicable currency; otherwise leaves it unapplied with a warning
Draft gets an editable Applies-to Vendor Inv. No. field and a read-only outcome field
Amount signs are normalised and the match is re-checked at finalization
quote: recognise a vendor credit note and create a purchase credit memo applied to the original invoice
